items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1958-09-24
items.q: Joe Pelletti, Pete Masarini. Johnny Covenzano.

ctx.x: He could play rolls and everything? Yeah, the way he'd hold them sticks in his hands with little nubs.

I don't understand. Yeah, Pete Masarini. Joe Pelletti, Pete Masarini. Johnny Covenzano. The part of my name was Joe Holbin. He used to play guitar. Joe Holbin. Clarinet player? No, played guitar. There was no clarinet player. Yeah. The clarinet player, I'll tell you who he was. Wait, we had so many of them at that time. Wait, I'm trying to think now. The clarinet player. I think his name was Frails. These people got a seat cover place on Ramport Street. Frails. Oh, God. I'm talking about 1913, 1912. Yeah, around…
